purpose: Teach: 異国/もとづい/予知/相反/強硬/残虐/妊婦/修道院

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は異国出身者だと、警察、把握ですね
lines.en: We understand the suspect in this case is a foreign national.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Level voice, even delivery. Straightforward statement of fact without inflection. The cadence of someone reading a briefing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、証拠にもとづいた捜査を進めております
lines.en: Our investigation is proceeding based on evidence.
lines.style: Steady, formal tone. Light pause between clauses. Clear enunciation on 'evidence.' Bureaucratic rhythm without coldness—this is protocol being followed correctly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察が地震予知能力を持つわけではありません
lines.en: That said, the police don't have the ability to predict earthquakes.
lines.style: Quiet, almost deflating observation. Gentle irony underneath—not mocking, just stating something true that needs saying. Slight hesitation, like offering a necessary correction to a friend.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、相反する証言を慎重に検討しております
lines.en: We're examining the conflicting testimonies with appropriate care.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate cadence. Weight on 'conflicting' and 'appropriate.' The tone of someone who has heard everything and is taking nothing for granted. Professional reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、強硬な対応を控えております
lines.en: The police have shown restraint rather than escalating this situation.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conciliatory. Soft opening. Acknowledgment in the voice—he's crediting them for something. Steady, not defensive. A small truth offered quietly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、残虐な犯行に断固対応します
lines.en: We will respond firmly to crimes of this severity.
lines.style: Shift in tone—stronger, more authoritative. Crisp attack on 'firmly.' Not aggressive, but no apology in the voice. The resolve of someone stating what must happen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、妊婦の被害者を警察、最優先で保護されたんですね
lines.en: It's clear the pregnant victim was your highest priority to protect.
lines.style: Softened recognition. Respectful, almost relieved tone. Not questioning—affirming. Pause before 'highest priority,' like he's acknowledging something he needed to see confirmed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、修道院敷地内での事件を捜査いたしました
lines.en: We conducted our investigation of the incident on the monastery grounds.
lines.style: Closing formality. Composed, almost reflective. Slower pace on 'monastery grounds'—the weight of location. This is the final statement: methodical, complete, settled.
